title: Lochhamer Straße, Planegg
description:
✔️ 22–24 m2 Superior Apartment — ideal for longer stays with extra comfort
✔️ High-quality box-spring bed (2 × 0.80 m or 1 × 1.60 m) & modern bathroom with shower
✔️ Kitchenette with fridge, stove, microwave, kettle, coffee capsule machine & basic kitchenware
✔️ 32" TV with international channels, balcony or terrace, fast WiFi included
✔️ Weekly cleaning included; quiet, well-connected location at Lochhamer Str. 6, 82152 Planegg

Superior Apartments – More Comfort for Longer Stays

Our Superior Apartments offer extra space and amenities for a relaxing stay, making them ideal for medium- to long-term travel. They combine comfort, convenience, and high-quality furnishings for a stress-free experience.

Enjoy a restful night in a high-quality box-spring bed, start your morning with freshly brewed coffee from the capsule machine, and benefit from weekly cleaning to keep your apartment spotless.

The Apartment

The 22–24 m2 apartment features a cozy living area, a kitchenette with fridge, stove, microwave, kettle, and essential kitchenware, and a modern bathroom with shower and hairdryer.

Entertainment and relaxation are provided by a 32-inch TV with international channels and a balcony or terrace, perfect for enjoying some fresh air or a quiet moment outside.

Building & Comfort

The apartment is located in a well-maintained building at Lochhamer Str. 6, 82152 Planegg, offering a quiet environment with all utilities included (heating, electricity, water, WiFi). Weekly cleaning ensures maximum convenience for longer stays.

title: Lochhamer Straße, Planegg

This fully furnished Standard Apartment offers an affordable yet comfortable living environment—perfect for students and young professionals who value convenience, privacy and smart use of space.
